claims.statement: A stream is an independent, bidirectional sequence of frames exchanged between the client and server within an HTTP/2 connection.

proof.quote: A stream is an independent, bidirectional sequence of frames exchanged between the client and server within an HTTP/2 connection.

claims.statement: HTTP/3 uses QUIC streams, preventing a lost packet on one stream from blocking delivery of data on other streams.

proof.quote: HTTP/3 uses QUIC streams, preventing a lost packet on one stream from blocking delivery of data on other streams.
